This root must connect supplied authentic content mappings to those owners; article DB coordinates are not MemoryContentIdentity.

P01 existing fixture/measurement/acceptance manifest authority freezes numerical rules before performance results; P02 revisioned configuration contract owns units/zero/omission semantics; P03 canonical ledger owns actual domains/admission/charge. No external prerequisite root owns these issues.

missingContract.producerOwnership: For each identity AEDS artifact key, an exclusively transferable actual IMemoryHostReadLease or actual IMemoryHostViewSource plus its current MemoryLocationToken, with stable immutable full frame bytes and the same canonical public eligibility/publication evidence.
missingContract.contentIdentity: Real MemoryContentIdentity(BlobId, ContentGeneration, RepresentationId) from the existing artifact/materialization owner. No mapping from article ID, publication timestamp, CurrentRevisionId, CurrentPublicationId or frame hash to all these owner identities currently exists in the projector.
missingContract.backingAdmission: Real payload/operation ResourceDomainId, current MemoryReservationCoordinator, admitted layout/capacity and hold limit, ResidencyRevision and DeviceEpoch from actual source owner. ManagedMemoryBacking.TryCreate requires these inputs; NativeMemoryArenaBuilder additionally requires frozen NativeMemoryArenaPolicy. The returned lease supplies Content/Location/Memory; raw arrays supply none of these facts.
missingContract.qualifiedSelection: For production capability selection, real MemoryCapabilityController/MemoryCapabilitySelection, current MemoryCapabilityWorkloadAdmission, MemoryGovernorDecision and original resource charges. Select/TryReserveOperation validate supplied facts; they neither create content identity nor return a materialized host read lease. No fabricated Qualified/Admitted status is permitted.
missingContract.sharedHoldPolicy: Frozen policy revision and positive maximumHolds including overlapping snapshot roots/immutable clones/current-last-good-sticky references and actual concurrent consumers, with explicit unit/count, exhaustion result, scope, zero/omission semantics and reload/drain behavior. Existing MaxArtifactObjects counts artifacts, not lease holds; MaxResidentBytes/overlap estimates are not a hold policy.
missingContract.metadataAdmission: Frozen bounded lease/representation/clone/consumer roster and conservative metadata capacity/headroom model for group arrays, HashSet/index entries, snapshot/gates and hold objects. Actual registered byte/operation domains, units, finite charge vector, reservation/conversion owner and release lifetime through final group/consumer completion are required before these allocations. Existing ledger entryLimit/eventCapacity bound ledger metadata, not snapshot ownership metadata. No physical layout or exact CLR header size may be fabricated.

ordinaryCodeGap: Original BuildSnapshotCoreAsync/materialization helpers do not receive a typed admitted backing result and therefore cannot call FromHostReadLease + WithHostReadLeases. Delta/view/taxonomy constructors also require producer-owned transfer of unchanged/new representation leases after authoritative inputs exist. The root ordinary attachment/consumer adapter already exists; adding a disconnected overload or wrapping raw arrays with new identities is not a genuine original-path connection.
